newsitem.title: POLAND: BOURSE LIFTS ESPEBEPE PRICE LIMITS THURS.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE LIFTS ESPEBEPE PRICE LIMITS THURS.

text.p: The Polish bourse will allow builder Espebepe SA to trade without the regular daily 10-percent price fluctuation limit on Thursday due to recent excess supply, the bourse said in a statement on Wednesday.

Espebepe has plunged 26 percent during the last three sessions with no trade after price-fixing due to excess supply after a court on Friday postponed the firm's creditors meeting deciding on a possible debt write-off deal.
"Due to the unbalanced market...the management of the Warsaw bourse has decided to lift the price change limits on...Espebepe for the bourse session on March 20," the statement said.
Espebepe has debts of about 75 million zlotys.
